data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present a rare 3-bedroom + maid’s villa in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club, an exclusive gated community designed around a world-class equestrian lifestyle.

This elegant home offers unobstructed views of the polo field, providing an exceptional sense of privacy, serenity, and open space — the perfect retreat for families seeking refined living in a resort-inspired environment.

Property Details:

• 3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
• Plot Size: Approx. 3,328.85 sq. ft.
• Open-plan layout with large windows and high ceilings
• Marble flooring and contemporary interiors
• Private garden and spacious terrace
• 2 covered parking spaces
• Solar power system
• 24/7 gated security

Community Amenities:

• 4 polo fields and a world-class equestrian center
• 5-star hotel within the community
• Polo academy & riding school
• Swimming pools and fully equipped gyms
• Tennis, paddle, and Pilates facilities
• Golf practice area
• Spa, salons & luxury retail
• Licensed restaurants & lounges
• Football and archery training areas

Additional Highlights:

• Exclusive financing options available through Provident Real Estate
• Limited villas with this premium polo field view and location

This isn’t just a home — it’s a lifestyle.
Contact us today to arrange your private viewing and experience luxury living at Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club.
